title: Sch-net: A Deep Learning Architecture for Automatic Schizophrenia Setection
summary: Sch-net uses deep learning on speech to distinguish schizophrenia patients from controls. External replication and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
ai_technology: Speech dataset contains 28 schizophrenia patients and 28 healthy controls; the source reports ablations and comparisons with feature-engineered/classical models.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Sch-net uses deep learning on speech to distinguish schizophrenia patients from controls.
evidence.unknown: External replication, causal effects and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
